messages.content: Are ATM withdrawals abroad free on Premium accounts?

response: According to our public FAQ, for customers with a Premium account, international ATM withdrawals are subject to a fee. However, this fee can be waived if you have activated the "Overseas Travel" service in your online banking profile. Please note that fees and services may vary depending on your specific account type and any additional features you've subscribed to. If you'd like more information or clarification, I recommend checking our website or contacting us for further assistance.
